tools.description: Search the public web through the isolated task browser and return ordered result links.
tools.name: search

tools.description: Navigate the active browser tab to an HTTP or HTTPS URL allowed by the network policy.
tools.name: navigate

tools.description: Read visible text and interactive element references from the active browser tab.
tools.name: read_page

tools.description: Click an element reference returned by read_page in the active tab.
tools.name: click

tools.description: Enter text into an editable element reference and optionally submit with Enter.
tools.name: type

tools.description: Press one allowed navigation or editing key in the active tab or on a referenced element.
tools.name: press

tools.description: Wait for a bounded duration or until exact visible text appears in the active tab.
tools.name: wait

tools.description: Capture a PNG screenshot of the active tab and return bounded base64 content.
tools.name: screenshot

tools.description: Click a referenced download control and return a bounded downloaded file as base64 with integrity metadata.
tools.name: download

tools.description: List, create, select, or close tabs in the isolated task browser.
tools.name: tabs
